create_ProlificUnit: create a ProlificUnit instance to track a worker's contribution to a Prolific assignment
get_status_ProlificUnit: get the current status of a ProlificUnit by querying the Prolific API directly
launch_ProlificUnit: launch a ProlificUnit to publish it on Prolific and make it available to workers
expire_ProlificUnit: expire a ProlificUnit by sending a request to expire the associated Prolific Study
register_from_provider_data_ProlificUnit: register a ProlificUnit with study and submission IDs from the Prolific provider data
